Our Responsible
Journey
A n n u a l R e p o rt 2 0 2 0 年年報
We remain confident in Samsonite’s long-term prospects. Because of
the unwavering commitment of our corporate, regional and country
management teams and our business partners around the world, the
responsiveness of our organization, and our incredible portfolio of brands
– each with its rich heritage, unique DNA and strong brand loyalty –
Samsonite is well-positioned for long-term growth and shareholder value
creation when the world starts to travel again.

我們仍然對新秀麗的長遠前景充滿信心。全賴我們的企業、地區及各國管理團
隊及世界各地的業務夥伴的不懈努力，我們組織的應變能力，加上我們卓越的
品牌組合（每個品牌各自秉承豐富的傳統，獨特的內涵及強大的品牌忠誠度），
當世界各地的人們再次踏上旅途時，新秀麗已經準備就緒，實現長遠增長和創
造股東價值。


Timothy Charles Parker
Chairman 主席

公司簡介

Samsonite International S.A. (the “Company”), together with its                 新秀麗國際有限公司（「本公司」，連同其綜合附
consolidated subsidiaries (the “Group”), is the world’s best-known              屬公司統稱為「本集團」）是全球最著名、規模最
and largest travel luggage company, with a heritage dating back                 大的行李箱公司，擁有逾 110 年悠久歷史。本集
more than 110 years. The Group is principally engaged in the design,            團主要在全球從事設計、製造、採購及分銷行
manufacture, sourcing and distribution of luggage, business and                 李箱、商務包及電腦包、戶外包及休閒包、旅
computer bags, outdoor and casual bags, travel accessories and slim             遊配件以及個人電子設備纖薄保護殼，旗下經
protective cases for personal electronic devices throughout the world,          營的品牌主要包括新秀麗 ®、Tumi ®、American
primarily under the Samsonite , Tumi , American Tourister , Speck ,
                                ®         ®                    ®          ®     Tourister ®、Speck ®、Gregory ®、High Sierra ®、
Gregory ®, High Sierra ®, Kamiliant ®, ebags ®, Lipault ® and Hartmann ®        Kamiliant ®、ebags ®、Lipault ® 及Hartmann ® 品牌
brand names as well as other owned and licensed brand names.                    以及其他自有及獲授權的品牌。


The Company’s Strategy                                                          本公司的策略
The Company aims to increase shareholder value through sustainable              本公司旨在透過可持續收益及盈利增長以及產生
revenue and earnings growth and free cash flow generation. In order             自由現金流量以提升股東價值。為達到此目標，
to achieve this objective, the Company has adopted the following                本公司已採納以下主要策略：
principal strategies:


•   Ensure the Company’s well-diversified family of brands attracts             •    確保本公司的多元化品牌組合吸引旅遊及非旅
    consumers at all price points in both the travel and non-travel                  遊行李箱、箱包及配件類別所有價格點的消費
    luggage, bag and accessories categories.                                         者。


•   Increase the proportion of net sales from the Company’s direct-to-          •    提升本公司直接面向消費者電子商貿渠道佔銷
    consumer e-commerce channel.                                                     售淨額的比重。


•   Focused investment in marketing to support the Company’s                    •    於營銷方面作出重點投資，以支持本公司的品
    brands and initiatives.                                                          牌及發展方案。


•   Continue to leverage the Company’s regional management                      •    繼續憑藉本公司的地區管理架構、採購及分銷
    structure, sourcing and distribution expertise and marketing engine              專長以及營銷動力，將其品牌拓展至新市場，
    to extend its brands into new markets and penetrate deeper into                  並加深滲透現有渠道。
    existing channels.


•   Continue to invest in research and development to develop lighter           •    繼續投資於研究與開發，以開發更輕巧及更堅
    and stronger new materials, advanced manufacturing processes,                    固的新物料、先進的製造技術、具吸引力的新
    exciting new designs, as well as innovative functionalities that                 設計，以及為消費者帶來實際效益的創新功
    deliver real benefits to consumers.                                              能。


•   Continue to incorporate the Company’s environmental, social and             •    繼續在本公司的核心業務中貫徹其環境、社會
    governance (“ESG”) philosophy into its core business practices                   及管治（「環境、社會及管治」）理念，落實本
    through “Our Responsible Journey” to lead the industry in                        公司「負責任之旅」長遠策略，引領行業可持
    sustainability and treat all stakeholders with fairness and respect in           續發展，並恪守本公司一直以來的座右銘「己
    line with the Company’s long-standing motto, “Do unto others as                  所不欲，勿施於人」，繼續公平對待及尊重所
    you would have them do unto you.”                                                有持份者。

                                 業績的影響，同時增強新秀麗的競爭優

In response to the COVID-19 pandemic, governments around the
world adopted various measures to contain the spread of the virus,
including travel restrictions, temporary closure of non-essential
businesses, quarantines and other social distancing measures. The
result was a near-complete halt in travel and tourism, which in turn
resulted in significantly reduced consumer demand for our products.
The Group’s net sales decreased by 26.1%(1) year-on-year during the
first quarter of 2020, when COVID-19 primarily impacted markets in
Asia. The year-on-year decrease in net sales widened to 77.9%(1) in            為應對2019冠狀病毒疫症大流行的情況，世界各

     manufacture, sourcing and distribution of luggage, business and computer bags, outdoor
     and casual bags, travel accessories and slim protective cases for personal electronic devices
     throughout the world, primarily under the Samsonite ®, Tumi ®, American Tourister ®, Speck ®,
     Gregory ®, High Sierra ®, Kamiliant ®, ebags ®, Lipault ® and Hartmann® brand names as well as
     other owned and licensed brand names.

Distribution Channels                                                        31日止年度的234.5百萬美元。

All of the Group’s distribution channels in North America recorded
year-on-year net sales decreases during the year ended December
31, 2020 due to the COVID-19 Impacts. Net sales in the wholesale
channel in North America decreased by US$373.4 million, or 50.4%
(-50.4% constant currency), for the year ended December 31, 2020
compared to the year ended December 31, 2019. Net sales to
e-retailers, which are included in the Group’s wholesale channel,
decreased by US$22.8 million, or 28.0% (-28.0% constant currency),
during the year ended December 31, 2020 compared to the previous
year as net sales through the Group’s e-retailer customers were
impacted less by lockdowns.

Net sales in the DTC channel, which includes company-operated retail
stores and DTC e-commerce, decreased by US$387.5 million, or
62.3% (-62.3% constant currency), year-on-year to US$234.5 million
for the year ended December 31, 2020 from US$621.9 million for the
year ended December 31, 2019.

 Notes 註釋
 (1) The geographic location of the Group’s net sales generally reflects the country from which its products were sold and does not necessarily
     indicate the country in which its end consumers were actually located.
     本集團銷售淨額的地域位置分佈一般反映出售產品的國家，並不一定為終端消費者實際所在的國家。
 (2) Net sales in Belgium were US$6.7 million and US$22.1 million for the years ended December 31, 2020 and December 31, 2019,
     respectively, a decrease of US$15.5 million, or 69.8% (-70.5% constant currency). Remaining sales consisted of direct shipments to
     distributors, customers and agents in other European countries, including e-commerce.
     截至2020年12月31日及2019年12月31日止年度，比利時的銷售淨額分別為6.7百萬美元及22.1百萬美元，減少15.5百萬美元或69.8%（按不
     變匯率基準計算則減少70.5%)。餘下的銷售額包括直接發貨予歐洲其他國家的分銷商、客戶及代理商（包括電子商貿）。
 (3) Net sales reported for the United Kingdom include net sales made in Ireland.
     英國錄得的銷售淨額包括於愛爾蘭錄得的銷售淨額。
 (4) Results stated on a constant currency basis, a non-IFRS measure, are calculated by applying the average exchange rate of the previous
     year to current year local currency results.
     按不變匯率基準計算呈列的業績為非IFRS財務計量工具，是以當地貨幣呈列的本年度業績採用去年的平均匯率計算所得。

Performance-based Restricted Share Units                                               績效掛鈎受限制股份單位

PRSUs vest in full on the third anniversary of the date of grant,                      績效掛鈎受限制股份單位僅於若干預先確定的累
subject to the grantee continuing to be employed by, or continuing                     計表現目標達成後，方會於授出日三年後全數
to provide services to, the Group on the vesting date, and only to                     歸屬，惟承授人須於歸屬日仍持續受聘於本集團
the extent certain pre-established cumulative performance targets                      或持續向本集團提供服務。並非按市況標準授出
are met. Expense related to PRSUs with non-market performance                          的績效掛鈎受限制股份單位的相關開支在績效期
criteria is recognized ratably over the performance period, net of                     內基於達到相關表現目標的概率按比例確認，並
estimated forfeitures, based on the probability of attainment of the                   已扣除估計已沒收績效掛鈎受限制股份單位的開
related performance targets. The potential number of shares that                       支。於績效掛鈎受限制股份單位歸屬時可能發行
may be issued upon vesting of the PRSUs ranges from 0% of the                          的股份數目介乎績效掛鈎受限制股份單位所涉目
target number of shares subject to the PRSUs, if the minimum level                     標股份數目的 0%（倘無法達到最低表現要求）至
of performance is not attained, to up to 200% of the target number of                  績效掛鈎受限制股份單位所涉目標股份數目的
shares subject to the PRSUs, if the level of performance is at or above                200%（倘達到或超過預先確定的最高表現要求）。
the predetermined maximum achievement level. For PRSUs subject to                      與市況相關的績效掛鈎受限制股份單位的開支於
market conditions, the expense is recognized over the vesting period                   歸屬期內確認，並按授出日採用蒙特卡羅模擬方
based on the fair value as determined on the grant date utilizing a                    法釐定的公允價值計算。
Monte Carlo simulation.

In the Company’s circular to shareholders dated September 3, 2018             於本公司日期為2018年9月3日內容有關（其中包
relating to, among other things, the grant of PRSUs, the Company              括）授出績效掛鈎受限制股份單位的致股東通函
stated that the final number of shares which will vest under the PRSUs        中，本公司指出績效掛鈎受限制股份單位項下將
will vary depending on the level of achievement of performance                歸屬的最終股數，將視乎適用於績效掛鈎受限制
conditions applicable to the PRSUs, thereby ensuring that the actual          股份單位的表現條件達成程度而有所不同，從而
payout is linked to the Company’s performance. The Remuneration               確保實際支付與本公司表現掛鈎。薪酬委員會釐
Committee determined that in relation to the PRSUs which were                 定，就 2018 年 10 月及 12 月授出的績效掛鈎受限
granted in October and December 2018, the performance conditions              制股份單位而言，表現條件基於(i) 2018 財政年

5. Impairment Charges                                                             5. 減值費用
       In accordance with International Accounting Standards (“IAS”)                     根據國際會計準則（「IAS」）第 36 號資產減
       36, Impairment of Assets (“IAS 36”), the Group is required to                     值（「IAS第36號」），本集團須至少每年或在
       evaluate its intangible assets with indefinite lives at least annually            發生事件或情況變化而導致現金產生單位
       or when an event has occurred or circumstances change that                        的可收回金額較有可能低於其賬面值時，
       would more likely than not reduce the recoverable amount of                       評估無限可用年期的無形資產。本集團亦
       a CGU below its carrying value. The Group is also required to                     須至少每季度審閱有限可用年期的有形及
       perform a review for impairment indicators at least quarterly on                  無形資產的減值跡象。倘有任何跡象表明
       its tangible and intangible assets with finite useful lives. If there             資產可能減值，則本集團須評估該資產或
       is any indication that an asset may be impaired, the Group must                   現金產生單位的可收回金額。
       estimate the recoverable amount of the asset or CGU.

            manage and control market risk exposures within acceptable                                 數之內，同時優化回報。
            parameters, while optimizing the return.

(g) Fair Value of Financial Instruments                                        (g) 金融工具之公允價值
      Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset                 公允價值是於計量日市場參與者於有秩序交
      or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between               易中出售資產可收取或轉讓負債須支付的價
      market participants at the measurement date. IFRS establishes                   格。IFRS 建立一套公允價值等級架構，該
      a fair value hierarchy that prioritizes the inputs to valuation                 架構排列用以計量公允價值的估值方法輸入
      techniques used to measure fair value. The hierarchy gives the                  數據的優先等級。該等級架構給予於活躍市
      highest priority to unadjusted quoted prices in active markets                  場中相同資產或負債的未經調整報價最高
      for identical assets or liabilities (Level 1 measurements) and                  等級（第一級別計量），以及涉及重大不可
      the lowest priority to measurements involving significant                       觀察輸入數據的計量最低等級（第三級別計
      unobservable inputs (Level 3 measurements). The three levels of                 量）。公允價值等級架構的三個級別如下：
      the fair value hierarchy are as follows:

      •    Level 1 inputs are quoted prices (unadjusted) in active                    •      第一級別輸入數據為本集團有能力於
           markets for identical assets or liabilities that the Group has                    計量日取得的相同資產或負債於活躍
           the ability to access at the measurement date.                                    市場的報價（未經調整）。
      •    Level 2 inputs are inputs other than quoted prices included                •      第二級別輸入數據為不包括第一級別
           within Level 1 that are observable for the asset or liability,                    的報價的資產或負債的可直接或間接
           either directly or indirectly.                                                    觀察的輸入數據。
      •    Level 3 inputs are unobservable inputs for the asset or                    •      第三級別輸入數據為資產或負債的不
           liability.                                                                        可觀察輸入數據。

      The level in the fair value hierarchy within which a fair                       公允價值計量在公允價值等級架構中的層級
      measurement in its entirety falls is based on the lowest level                  分類，乃基於對公允價值計量整體而言屬重
      input that is significant to the fair value measurement in its                  大的最低層級輸入數據。
      entirety.
